title: The Animal With Three Hearts
hook: An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue.
script: An octopus has three hearts, and its blood is blue. Its blue blood carries oxygen with copper, where ours uses iron. Thick blood like that is hard to pump, so the work is split up. So what happens when an octopus swims? The main heart stops beating, so it would rather crawl. Swimming tires it out fast, which is why octopuses rest in dens between hunts. Why would any animal have blue blood at all? Copper carries oxygen well in cold, dark water, and that is where an octopus lives.
